metadata.description: Frontend workflow challenges and debugging prompt system
metadata.purpose: AI-assisted debugging and workflow resumption with token optimization

component_initialization.description: Components failing to initialize properly, lifecycle issues
root_causes: DOM elements not ready when component init() called
Async operations completing out of order
Missing error handling in lifecycle hooks
Event listeners not properly cleaned up
State observers not unsubscribed on destroy

debug_prompt.system_context: You are debugging component initialization issues. The codebase uses ES6 modules with async/await patterns and a BaseComponent class.
debug_prompt.user_prompt_template: Component {component_name} is failing to initialize. Error: {error_message}. Check initialization order, DOM readiness, and lifecycle hooks. Provide fix with proper error handling.
optimization_hints: Check element existence before DOM operations

checklist: Verify DOM element exists before attachToDOM()
Verify parent component initialized before child

api_service_integration.description: API calls failing, authentication issues, response parsing errors
root_causes: Token not retrieved from localStorage before request
Response format mismatch (success wrapper vs direct data)
Missing error handling for network failures

debug_prompt.system_context: You are debugging API service integration. The app uses BaseApiService with interceptors for auth and response processing.
debug_prompt.user_prompt_template: API call to {endpoint} is failing with {error_type}: {error_message}. Check token retrieval, interceptor chain, and response format. Endpoint: {endpoint}, Method: {method}.
optimization_hints: Handle both {success: true, data: ...} and direct data formats
Add retry logic for network errors

checklist: Check token exists before making authenticated requests
Handle both response formats (wrapped and direct)
Implement retry logic for transient failures

state_management_sync.description: State not updating, observers not firing, stale state issues
common_symptoms: UI not updating after state change
Stale state being used in components
root_causes: Deep object mutations instead of immutable updates
Observers not cleaned up on component destroy

debug_prompt.system_context: You are debugging state management. The app uses AppStore with observer pattern for state updates.
debug_prompt.user_prompt_template: State change for {state_path} is not updating UI. Check observer subscriptions, state update method, and component re-render logic. State path: {state_path}, Expected value: {expected_value}.
required_context: How state is being updated (setState call)
optimization_hints: Filter changes in observer: if (!data.changes['data.toilets']) return
Use immutable updates: {...prevState, data: {...prevState.data, toilets: newToilets}}
Check observer is called in component lifecycle

checklist: Check observer filters for correct state paths
Trigger component update() after state changes

map_initialization_failures.description: Leaflet map not rendering, markers not appearing, cluster issues
root_causes: Leaflet library not loaded before map init
map.invalidateSize() not called after container resize

debug_prompt.system_context: You are debugging Leaflet map initialization. The app uses Leaflet with MarkerClusterGroup plugin.
debug_prompt.user_prompt_template: Map in {page_name} is not displaying. Check Leaflet availability, container dimensions, and marker data. Error: {error_message}, Container: {container_selector}.
optimization_hints: Check typeof L !== 'undefined' before map creation
Set explicit height on map container: element.style.height = '500px'
Use L.markerClusterGroup() if available, fallback to L.layerGroup()

checklist: Verify Leaflet loaded: if (typeof L === 'undefined') throw
Set map container dimensions before init
Add error handlers for tile loading

qr_scanner_issues.description: QR scanner not initializing, camera permission issues, scan failures
root_causes: Scanner not cleaned up on page destroy

debug_prompt.system_context: You are debugging QR scanner issues. The app uses Html5Qrcode library for QR code scanning.
debug_prompt.user_prompt_template: QR scanner in {page_name} is not working. Check library availability, camera permissions, and scanner lifecycle. Error: {error_message}.
optimization_hints: Check for existing scanner before creating new
Validate scanned data format before processing

checklist: Stop scanner before creating new instance
Clean up scanner in destroy() method
Validate QR code format (URL vs ID)
Handle scan errors without breaking flow

event_listener_leaks.description: Event listeners not removed, memory leaks, duplicate handlers
common_symptoms: Event handlers still active after destroy
root_causes: Event listeners not cleaned up in destroy()
Anonymous functions not tracked for removal

debug_prompt.system_context: You are debugging event listener leaks. Components must track and clean up all event listeners.
debug_prompt.user_prompt_template: Event listener leak detected in {component_name}. Check cleanup in destroy() method and event listener tracking. Component: {component_name}, Event: {event_type}.
optimization_hints: Store listener cleanup functions in this.eventListeners Map
Use component.addEventListener() which returns cleanup function
Use once: true for one-time listeners
Check for duplicate subscriptions before adding

checklist: Store all cleanup functions in this.eventListeners
Check for existing listeners before adding
Use addEventListener from dom.utils with cleanup
Test memory usage in dev tools

async_operation_race_conditions.description: Async operations completing out of order, stale data, race conditions
common_symptoms: Multiple API calls overriding each other
Updates applied to wrong component instance
root_causes: Multiple async operations not awaited together
No cancellation tokens for in-flight requests
State updates based on stale data
Component destroyed but async operation continues
Race conditions in parallel Promise.all() calls

debug_prompt.system_context: You are debugging async race conditions. The app uses async/await extensively.
debug_prompt.user_prompt_template: Race condition in {function_name}. Multiple async operations completing out of order. Function: {function_name}, Operations: {operation_list}.
required_context: Whether component can be destroyed during operation
optimization_hints: Use Promise.all() for parallel independent operations
Use request IDs to track and cancel stale requests
Await all dependencies before dependent operations

checklist: Use AbortController for cancellable fetch requests
Track request IDs to ignore stale responses

form_validation_and_submission.description: Form validation errors, submission failures, state not clearing
common_symptoms: Loading state not clearing on error
root_causes: Form state not reset after success
Error handling missing in catch blocks

debug_prompt.system_context: You are debugging form submission issues. Forms use preventDefault() and async submission.
debug_prompt.user_prompt_template: Form {form_id} submission failing. Check validation, loading state, and error handling. Form: {form_id}, Error: {error_message}.

checklist: Use finally block to clear loading state

strategies: Only include relevant file paths, not full file contents
Use line number ranges for large files
Reference component names instead of full code
Focus on specific error messages, not full stack traces

prompt_chaining.description: Break complex debugging into sequential prompts
rules: Follow with root cause analysis prompt
Each prompt should reference previous results
Maintain context between prompts using session summary

chain_template.prompt: Identify the issue: {symptom}. Check {relevant_files}. What is the root cause?
chain_template.expected_output: Root cause analysis with file:line references

chain_template.prompt: Based on diagnosis: {root_cause}, provide fix for {component/file}. Include error handling.
Verify fix for {component} handles edge cases: {edge_cases}. Add tests if needed.
chain_template.expected_output: Edge case handling and test suggestions

guidelines: Use issue IDs to track parallel debugging

example.note: These can be debugged simultaneously as they are independent

template.expected_output: Fixed component code with proper lifecycle management

error_recovery_prompts.description: Prompts for resuming workflow after errors
error_recovery_prompts.resume_template: Workflow interrupted at {step}. Error: {error}. Current state: {state}. Resume from: {resume_point}. Fix error and continue.

optimizations: Use structuredClone() or immutable patterns instead of JSON serialization
Add AbortController support for all async operations
Use WeakMap for event listener tracking

issues: No request cancellation on page destroy
optimizations: Import dom.utils at top level, not in method
Cancel all in-flight requests on destroy
Filter state changes in observer before processing

issues: Deep merge can be slow for large state
optimizations: Batch state updates in single setState call
Dynamic imports for page modules (already done)
Lazy load heavy components (QR scanner, map)

steps: 2. Review error logs and console output
3. Use appropriate debug prompt from critical_challenges

example_1_component_init.prompt: Component ButtonComponent is failing to initialize. Error: Cannot read property 'appendChild' of null. Check initialization order, DOM readiness, and lifecycle hooks. Component extends BaseComponent. File: src/components/ui/button.component.js:46.
example_1_component_init.expected_fix: Add null check before appendChild, ensure element created before render

example_2_api_auth.prompt: API call to /api/toilet/map is failing with 401: Unauthorized. Check token retrieval, interceptor chain, and response format. Token present in localStorage: yes. Endpoint: /api/toilet/map, Method: GET.
example_2_api_auth.expected_fix: Verify token added to Authorization header, check interceptor order

example_3_state_update.symptom: UI not updating after state change
example_3_state_update.prompt: State change for data.toilets is not updating UI. Component: HomePage. Observer subscribed in setupStateObservers(). Check observer subscriptions, state update method, and component re-render logic.
example_3_state_update.expected_fix: Verify observer callback triggers update(), check state path filtering
